import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

The digest flood is a false-positive `openai-key` scan, not leaked keys. Four parked bob-cli publication items retry forever because withholds do not charge quarantine, and the `agent_publication` chop scores each retry as `check_error`.

**Report:** `research:202611/agent_publication_protection_withholds/agent_publication_protection_withholds__grk.md`  
**Snapshot:** `file:explicit:1a9322327d94f479d2f1194c`

### What the digest is

All 71 rows are `gh_bobs-org__bob-cli` / `agent_publication` / `check_error` from 12:01–12:55 ET on 2026-11-02, about one every 43 seconds. The typical line is one run withhold plus three prompt-archive withholds. That is `"; ".join(item_errors)` from four live outbox keys with `attempts=0`.

### Who introduced it

| Layer | Agents |
| --- | --- |
| Scanner + park-without-quarantine | `sase-1oh.5.1.3` (`0f76e05de4`), `sase-1oh.5.1.land--3--code` (`c687d8b6eb`); `openai-key` regex from `7806f587` |
| Flood start | `research.5n.mus` at 18:49 on 2026-11-01: `blocked-task-why-visual__mus.md` path hit `meta.json` (structural), so the whole run is withheld |
| Prompt-archive clauses still looping | `bob-cli-fs.8.1.3` (08:48 on 2026-11-02) and `bob-cli-fx.2` twice (revision + linked, 11:08) |

### Root cause

`openai-key` is unanchored `sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}`. The last two letters of `task` plus the hyphen overlay `sk-`, so kebab names such as `task-status-cycler-*` and `blocked-task-why-visual__mus-…` match. Structural `meta.json` or a prompt archive parks the item with `increment_attempts=False`. The doorbell retries the same keys; axe appends another digest row.

A second, already-settled class in the same digest is deferred prompt-archive restore for `bob-cli-fs.2.1.land` (`@fdc34de9bf82`, `@07e115192e51`). That path charges attempts and quarantined at 12:21:17.

Tightening the regex with a leading word boundary, then re-scanning or dropping the four blocked ledger rows, stops the loop. Scoring protection withholds as doctor WARN instead of chop `check_error` is an independent lever. Renaming the four source files is the wrong fix: the “secret” is bob-cli’s own `task-*` vocabulary.
